# Current Objective

Fix daily report Store B September totals without changing protected data/config/checker files.

# Completed

- Inspected report aggregation, refund booking, monetary parsing, timezone parsing, and baseline checker; A/C match while B has 16 daily mismatches.

# Decisions

- Root cause is parse_offset for a negative offset with minutes: it uses timedelta(hours=-3, minutes=30), which normalizes to -02:30 for configured Store B -03:30. Correct sign must apply to both hour and minute fields. Sales and refunds already use the shared local-time conversion and documented business-day/refund rules.

# Next Suggested Step

Confirm with debug placement and patch report/timezones.py, then rerun checker.

# Current Objective

Fix daily report Store B September totals without changing protected files.

# Completed

- Inspected report aggregation, refund booking, monetary parsing, timezone parsing, and baseline checker; A/C match while B has 16 daily mismatches.
- Confirmed -03:30 was incorrectly parsed as -02:30; patched report/timezones.py so the sign applies to minute components. Checker improved from 16 to 2 mismatches (B Sep 17 and Sep 23).
- Identified nine exact duplicate Store B receipts: six booked Sep 17 totaling .53 and three booked Sep 23 totaling .76, precisely matching the residual overages. Updated aggregation to count each (store, terminal, receipt) only once; IDs cannot serve as source identity because imports assign them.
- Timezone parser fix and receipt de-duplication now make all expected store-day totals match.

# Decisions

- Root cause is parse_offset for a negative offset with minutes: it uses timedelta(hours=-3, minutes=30), which normalizes to -02:30 for configured Store B -03:30. Correct sign must apply to both hour and minute fields. Sales and refunds already use the shared local-time conversion and documented business-day/refund rules.
- The shared time conversion was one confirmed cause; two residual mismatches indicate a separate report-code defect, likely in transaction/refund handling rather than timezone placement.
- Keep de-duplication in daily_totals, not the ledger loader, so debug_report continues to expose every imported row and the report alone applies receipt-level business identity.

# Next Suggested Step

Review final diff and hand off completed change.
